title: Discovering Bandwidth-Efficient Prefetchers to Shrink the Cache Hierarchy
abstract: arXiv:2611.31983v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Shared last-level caches (LLCs) increasingly dominate server processor die area, forcing architects to trade core counts for cache capacity. While intelligent data prefetching offers a pathway to reclaim this silicon, designing coordinated, multi-level prefetching policies for multi-core systems is bottlenecked by day-long, cycle-level simulations. This simulation wall limits even LLM-based microarchitecture discovery; the state-of-the-art ArchAgent system evolves one cache level at a time on single-core benchmarks, adds multi-core configurations only at the end, and trails the human champion under multi-core shared cache contention. We introduce DuoArchitect, an autonomous agentic framework for multi-fidelity, multi-core co-discovery of prefetchers. Agents jointly evolve evaluation proxies and coordinated prefetching policies across the L1D, L2, and LLC hierarchies, constructing simulation proxies 3-26x faster than cluster evaluation an

translated_title: 发现带宽高效的预取器以缩小缓存层次结构
translated_abstract: 共享末级缓存（LLC）日益占据服务器处理器芯片面积的主导地位，迫使架构师在核心数量与缓存容量之间进行取舍。虽然智能数据预取提供了一条回收这些硅片面积的途径，但为多核系统设计协调的多级预取策略却受制于耗时一整天的周期级仿真。这一仿真瓶颈甚至限制了基于LLM的微架构探索；最先进的ArchAgent系统在单核基准测试中一次只演化一个缓存层级，仅在最后才加入多核配置，并且在多核共享缓存竞争下落后于人类冠军方案。我们提出了DuoArchitect，一个用于多保真度、多核协同发现预取器的自主智能体框架。智能体在L1D、L2和LLC层级上共同演化评估代理与协调的预取策略，所构建的仿真代理比集群评估快3-26倍……
tldr: 本文提出DuoArchitect——一个自主智能体框架，通过多保真度仿真与多核协同演化，联合发现覆盖L1D、L2和LLC各层级的协调带宽高效预取策略，其仿真速度比传统集群评估快3-26倍，从而帮助缩小缓存层次结构、释放芯片面积。
en_tdlr: DuoArchitect is an autonomous agentic framework that co-discovers coordinated, bandwidth-efficient prefetchers across the L1D, L2, and LLC hierarchy through multi-fidelity, multi-core joint evolution, building simulation proxies 3-26x faster than cluster evaluation.
